component.name: Video Cut
component.summary: Fast, lightweight video editor to cut, merge, crop, and rotate clips

description.p: Video Cut is an easy-to-use, fast, and lightweight video editor inspired by macOS QuickTime and Preview. It lets you cut and merge videos, add images with audio soundtracks, crop, and rotate clips on an intuitive filmstrip timeline with multi-format export.

ul.li: Frame-accurate video cutting, slicing, and trimming
Merge multiple videos and images into a single timeline
Interactive crop tool with aspect ratio presets (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21)
Rotate (90° CW/CCW) and flip (horizontal/vertical) clips
Import photos and graphics with customizable duration and optional background soundtrack
Drag-and-drop segment reordering with smooth undo and redo history
Desktop clipboard copy & paste integration for clips and images
Fast export with standard MP4 or advanced options (containers, codecs, CRF quality, speed presets)

screenshot.caption: Main application window with multi-segment filmstrip timeline
Crop and rotate dialog with aspect ratio presets and rule-of-thirds grid
Image segment import dialog with duration presets and soundtrack audio

ul.li: Official Flatpak distribution support targeting the GNOME 49 runtime
Instant Crop & Rotate dialog opening (< 20ms) with progressive background frame loading
Dual-mode full-quality preview frame (direct player capture or keyframe thumbnail)
Ultra-fast Cairo ARGB32 image surface creation via direct NumPy memory mapping (16ms vs 226ms)
Non-blocking asynchronous image import with reusable ProgressModal dialog
Modular ClipboardController architecture and automated benchmark test suite
Enhanced About window with community links, issue tracker, and project metadata
64-bit architecture restrictions and DirectFB exclusions for Snap packages
Desktop Drag & Drop: drag videos and photos directly from file managers into the editor
Clipboard integration: copy and paste video clips and image files directly across apps
Crop & Rotate enhancements: added 3:4 and 9:21 presets with auto-inversion upon rotation
Dedicated fullscreen mode toggle button and keyboard shortcut (F11)
Export redesign with prominent primary action and advanced settings popover
Image import duration presets (1s, 3s, 5s, 10s) and preserved source image stems
Audio and playback continuity improvements across segment transitions

description.p: Bug fixes and usability refinements across Linux desktop environments and packages.
